stanza: Of the white lines on the free freeway

prisoner.line: Seal the river at its mouth, take the water prisoner
stanza: Salvation sat and crossed herself and called the Devil "partner"
Wisdom burned upon a shelf, who'll kill the raging cancer
Seal the river at its mouth, take the water prisoner
Fill the sky with screams and cries, bathe in fiery answers
Enough! You talk of the people's rights
The people have only those rights which I choose to give them
And that is for their own good, believe me
They disappoint me, they must work faster
Ah yes, the young traitor who has tried to turn my people against me
Watch him, I have special plans for that one
